detectionRule: Resolve every approved symbol against the installed KiCad library and reject any PWR_FLAG plan whose non-ground rail is absent, whose source ref is missing, or whose source component is not connected to that rail.
rootCause: A legacy generic TVS identifier was treated as authoritative even though KiCad 10 does not ship it, the NUP2105 common-anode pin was mapped incorrectly, footprint aliases such as USB-C S1 were used as schematic pin IDs instead of SH, and power flags were inferred from net-name patterns instead of explicit power-source intent. A redundant flag on a regulator power-output also creates a real ERC conflict.
fixStrategy: Use KiCad's manufacturer-specific Power_Protection:NUP2105L definition with cathodes 1/2 and common-anode ground pin 3. Emit PWR_FLAG only from an explicit source-backed plan validated against the real component pin map; assert the passive external VUSB supply and return, but not the regulator's existing power-output pin.
regressionTest: authoritative-schematic-erc.integration.test.mjs resolves NUP2105, exercises fail-closed power assertions, and requires real KiCad 10 ERC zero on the representative ESP32 topology.
futureAutoApplyRule: Never synthesize a production symbol under a missing library ID and never add PWR_FLAG based only on a rail-name regex. Resolve the symbol first and prove the asserted rail is delivered by a named connected source component.
